The '''Parasite Chunk Barrier''' is a [[Debug Items|Creative-Only]] [[:Category:Blocks|Block]].
{{Item Info
|image1=Parasite Chunk Barrier.png
|id=srparasites:parasite_barrier
}}

==''Obtainment''==
Can only be obtained from the Creative Menu or with Cheats.

==''Usage''==
The Parasite Chunk Barrier, as its name suggests, pushes all Scape and Run entities (including projectiles like the [[Quench]]) out of a set chunk radius. This radius can be configured by right clicking the block and goes up to a maximum of ten chunks.
